entries.title: Vampire Survivors
entries.definitive_edition: Vampire Survivors on Windows PC with all released DLC through Ante Chamber

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all released DLC installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current full DLC catalog.

primary.version: Current PC release with released DLC through Ante Chamber
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it supports the base game, free updates, the major paid crossover expansions, the free Emerald Diorama and Ante Chamber expansions, and PC capture/settings flexibility. Apple Arcade is convenient but it is a condensed package with only the base game, free updates, Legacy of the Moonspell, and Tides of the Foscari, so PC is the safer complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Vampire Survivors on Steam for Windows PC, install all released DLC/expansions currently available there, and revisit the entry when the 2026 Legacy of the Bloodmoon expansion leaves upcoming status.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the full Steam DLC catalog and capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete current content route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: same desktop family, but Windows remains the preferred capture/settings target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Apple Arcade and some non-PC routes are convenient, but PC is the safest complete-DLC route; Legacy of the Bloodmoon is listed as an upcoming 2026 DLC on Steam and should be revisited after release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Vampire Survivors+ is not the full DLC stack; Legacy of the Bloodmoon is a 2026 upcoming expansion, so the entry should be updated when it releases.
